messages:
Rowan: quick follow-up from the postmortem — captured a concise set of rollout guardrails we should adopt to prevent repeat blast-radius incidents.
Priya: the core issue was an unscoped feature flag that ramped quickly. we need safer defaults + an automated containment chain.
Diego: agree. propose three levers: schema defaults, runtime detector, and operator controls (quarantine + fast-unpublish).
Maya: runtime detector should require two correlated signals (ewma error, p95 latency delta, or user-visible error rate) before pausing. avoid single-signal noisy pauses.
Rowan: proposed defaults: sample_scope=org_tag, default_sample_pct=1, ramp windows [5,15,60] mins, block >10% without manual approval. add max_tokens_cap per-flag to limit token storms.
Priya: SDK change: add `fallback_variant` + `max_tokens_per_request`. i'll own PR and CI tests. due 2025-05-04.
Diego: i'll build detector prototype emitting `canary_health` and implement two-signal rule + EWMA smoothing. due 2025-05-08.
Maya: ops rules: slack notify on pause, page only when auto-rollback occurs. set EWMA window 3m and require min evidence of 3m.
Rowan: example guard snippet:
```
{"flag":"rerank-v2","scope":"org_tag","tag":"beta","sample_pct":1,"ramps_mins":[5,15,60],"auto_pause":{"ewma_mins":3,"err_pct":2,"latency_mult":1.5},"auto_rollback":{"pause_mins":10}}
```
Priya: i'll add CI lint to prevent new flag templates defaulting to global.
Diego: simulator: replay recent incident traffic and assert pause triggers before peak error. i'll add `tools/canary_replay.sh`. due 2025-05-06.
Rowan: action items: Priya -> SDK PR (2025-05-04); Diego -> detector + sim (2025-05-08); Maya -> console quarantine UI + runbook (2025-05-10); Rowan -> postmortem board cards and follow-up sync.
Maya: add monthly audit: list global flags, owners, exposure_count; auto-tag flags with >1 exposure in 90d.
Priya: policy: global scope allowed only with documented risk ack and manual approval. enforcement in deploy flow.
deploy-bot: [ci] canary-guardrails/basic-tests passed on staging.
Rowan: thanks team — reconvene in one week to review staging sim results. :thumbsup:
